name: The Hacker: Protocol Zer0
storyline: The hacker known as Mr. X got away at the airport and vanished, leaving only his black trolley suitcase behind. On your first day at C.O.R.E, the cyber agency hunting him, the trolley lands on your table in the forensic lab, together with a message: "Protocol 0 started." Guided step by step by your handler, Agent Throne, you take his gear apart, turn his own tricks against him and follow his trail far beyond the lab: into his smart home, through a stream of new evidence, and all the way down to classified Level 5. Every lock you open brings you closer to what Protocol 0 really is.
summary: The Hacker: Protocol Zer0 is a first-person 3D escape-room and puzzle adventure. On their first day at the cyber agency C.O.R.E, the player receives a locked trolley that the hacker Mr. X left behind at an airport, together with the message "Protocol 0 started." The player inspects objects in 3D (rotating, flipping, zooming and using a magnifier) to find clues, opens a chain of locks and devices, builds tools from items on the lab bench, and follows the investigation beyond the lab. An in-game handler, Agent Throne, gives step-by-step hints on request. The game has about 90 puzzles and around 8 hours of play; a free demo covering Act 1 runs in a web browser. It supports 13 languages and can be played with the mouse alone.
